title: Infrastructure Ltd v. NHAI
text: The petitioner, Infrastructure Ltd, files an application under Section 11 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act for appointment of an arbitrator in a dispute with NHAI arising from a highway construction contract. The contract contains an arbitration clause. NHAI resisted the application claiming the dispute does not fall within the arbitration clause. The High Court examines the arbitration clause and the nature of the dispute. Under Section 11 of the Arbitration Act, the court's enquiry is limited to the existence of a valid arbitration agreement. The arbitration clause is wide and covers all disputes arising from the contract. The alleged breach of contract and consequential damages claimed by the petitioner fall squarely within the arbitration clause. The court appoints a retired High Court judge as sole arbitrator. The parties are directed to appear before the arbitrator within 15 days. The consideration for specific performance is to be adjudicated by the arbitrator.
